s:tokushima/naruto-whirlpools: View from a sightseeing boat in the Naruto Strait: a large swirling whirlpool of churning blue-green water and white foam, the massive Onaruto suspension bridge overhead, small rocky islets, bright spring sunshine, spray in the air.
s:tokushima/otsuka-museum: Inside the Otsuka Museum of Art: the full-size ceramic-panel reproduction of the Sistine Chapel, its vaulted ceiling and walls covered with Renaissance figures in muted colours, soft even lighting, a polished floor, a few small distant visitors looking up.
s:tokushima/iya-kazurabashi: Iya Kazurabashi: a rustic suspension bridge woven from thick brown vines with widely spaced wooden slats, sagging across a clear green river in a steep forested gorge, maples turning red and orange, soft overcast autumn light, a few small distant people crossing.
s:tokushima/oboke-gorge: Oboke Gorge from a sightseeing boat: the emerald-green Yoshino River flowing between smooth grey crystalline schist cliffs with striped water-worn patterns, forested slopes in autumn red and yellow above, a wooden tour boat ahead, soft overcast light.
s:tokushima/ochiai-village: View from the opposite hillside of Ochiai Village in Higashi-Iya: old farmhouses with steep roofs, stone walls and small terraced fields stacked down a very steep mountainside, autumn foliage, wisps of morning mist drifting in the valley.
s:tokushima/awa-odori-kaikan: Evening view from the summit of Mount Bizan over Tokushima City: city lights spreading across a flat plain to the sea, rivers curving through, the distant coastline of the Kii Channel, deep blue twilight sky, clear air.
s:tokushima/udatsu-street: Wakimachi Udatsu street: two-storey Edo-period merchant houses with white plaster walls, black tiled roofs and raised udatsu firewalls at the eaves, wooden lattice fronts, a narrow paved street, soft spring morning light, no people.
f:tokushima/tokushima-ramen: A bowl of Tokushima ramen: dark brown rich pork-bone soy broth with medium noodles, slices of sweet simmered pork belly, bean sprouts, green onion and a raw egg yolk on top, in a white bowl with a small bowl of rice beside, 45-degree angle, warm light.
f:tokushima/naruto-kintoki: Roasted Naruto Kintoki sweet potatoes with deep purple-red skin, one broken open to show steaming golden-yellow flesh, on a rustic ceramic plate on a wooden table, 45-degree angle, warm natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:tokushima/sudachi: Small round dark-green sudachi citrus, some whole and one halved to show pale juicy flesh, beside a grilled salted fish on a long ceramic plate, on a wooden table, 45-degree angle, soft autumn daylight, shallow depth of field.
f:tokushima/iya-soba: A bowl of Iya soba: short, thick, rustic grey-brown buckwheat noodles in a light clear broth with green onion, in a simple ceramic bowl on a wooden table by a window overlooking green mountains, 45-degree angle, soft natural light, light steam.
s:kagawa/chichu-art-museum: Exterior of the Chichu Art Museum on Naoshima: smooth grey concrete walls and geometric openings set into a green hillside, a sunken angular courtyard, the calm Seto Inland Sea beyond, bright clear morning light, sharp shadows, no people.
s:kagawa/naoshima-honmura: A quiet lane in Honmura village on Naoshima island: low traditional wooden houses with dark charred-cedar walls and grey tiled roofs, a small shrine gate, potted plants, the calm blue Seto Inland Sea glimpsed at the end of the lane, soft late-afternoon light.
s:kagawa/teshima-art-museum: Teshima Art Museum: a low white concrete shell shaped like a water droplet resting among green rice terraces on a hillside above the Seto Inland Sea, two large oval openings in its roof, bright late-spring sunlight, clear sky, no people.
s:kagawa/ritsurin-garden: Ritsurin Garden in late autumn: a wide pond with a small wooden boat, a graceful arched wooden bridge, sculpted pines and bright red maples reflected in still water, a teahouse on the shore, forested Mount Shiun rising behind, soft afternoon light.
s:kagawa/kotohira-gu: The long stone stairway of the Kotohira-gu approach: worn granite steps lined with stone lanterns and tall cedar trees climbing toward a dark wooden gate, dappled late-morning light, a few small distant pilgrims.
s:kagawa/chichibugahama: Chichibugahama Beach at sunset at low tide: wide flat wet sand with shallow tidal pools mirroring the orange and pink sky perfectly, a few small distant silhouetted figures reflected in the water, calm windless evening, low sun over the Seto Inland Sea.
s:kagawa/shodoshima: Angel Road on Shodoshima at low tide: a narrow bar of pale sand linking small pine-covered islets across calm turquoise water, gentle ripples on both sides, bright morning sunlight, clear sky, a few small distant walkers.
s:kagawa/yashima: View from the Yashima summit plateau at dusk: Takamatsu city and harbour spread below, the calm Seto Inland Sea dotted with small islands, sky fading from orange to deep blue, first city lights appearing, pine trees framing the foreground.
f:kagawa/sanuki-udon: A bowl of Sanuki kake udon: thick, glossy, square-edged wheat noodles in clear light-golden dashi broth, topped with chopped green onion and a piece of shrimp tempura, in a white ceramic bowl on a wooden tray, 45-degree angle, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:kagawa/honetsuki-dori: Marugame honetsuki-dori: a whole roasted chicken leg on the bone with crisp, blistered golden-brown skin glistening with garlic-pepper oil, on a metal plate with shredded cabbage soaking in the juices, a glass of beer blurred behind, 45-degree angle, warm light.
f:kagawa/olive-products: An unlabelled glass bottle of golden-green olive oil beside a white dish of glossy green pickled olives and a sprig of olive leaves, on a light wooden table outdoors with olive trees softly blurred behind, 45-degree angle, bright natural daylight, shallow depth of field.
s:ehime/dogo-onsen-honkan: Front of Dogo Onsen Honkan at dusk: a multi-tiered wooden bathhouse with layered grey tiled roofs, latticed windows glowing warm from within and a small red-glass turret on top, a stone-paved square in front, deep blue evening sky.
s:ehime/matsuyama-castle: Matsuyama Castle on Katsuyama hill: a dark wooden keep with white plaster trim and grey tiled roofs, surrounded by tall layered stone walls and turrets, cherry trees in full bloom in the foreground, clear blue spring sky, bright late-morning light.
s:ehime/shimanami-kaido: View from the Mount Kiro observatory on Oshima: the long triple suspension spans of the Kurushima-Kaikyo Bridge stretching across the strait toward Imabari, small islands and swirling currents below, calm blue Seto Inland Sea, golden sunset light, clear sky.
s:ehime/oyamazumi-shrine: Oyamazumi Shrine on Omishima: a massive ancient camphor tree with a gnarled thick trunk and wide spreading branches, wrapped with a straw shimenawa rope, beside a dark wooden shrine hall, gravel grounds, soft green dappled light, no people.
s:ehime/uchiko-ozu: Garyu Sanso in Ozu: a rustic thatched tea pavilion built on wooden supports over a rocky cliff above the wide Hiji River, surrounded by red and orange autumn maples, calm water below, soft late-autumn afternoon light.
s:ehime/shimonada-station: Shimonada Station at sunset: a single concrete platform with a small bench and a simple shelter, the calm Iyo-nada sea spreading directly beyond the platform edge, the low sun casting a golden path on the water, orange sky, no train.
s:ehime/ishizuchi: The summit ridge of Mount Ishizuchi in early October: a sharp rocky crest with steep grey crags, slopes covered in red, orange and yellow autumn foliage, layered blue mountains fading into the distance, clear sky, crisp morning light.
f:ehime/taimeshi: Uwajima-style taimeshi: slices of raw sea bream in a bowl of soy-based sauce with raw egg, sesame and green onion, beside a lacquered bowl of hot white rice and small side dishes on a wooden tray, 45-degree angle, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:ehime/mikan: Several bright orange Ehime mikan with glossy dimpled skin and a few green leaves, one peeled into segments, beside a glass of fresh orange juice on a light wooden table, 45-degree angle, soft natural window light, shallow depth of field.
f:ehime/jakoten: Freshly fried jakoten fish cakes: flat greyish-brown patties with a coarse speckled texture, on a small plate with a dab of grated ginger, a glass of beer softly blurred behind, on a wooden counter, 45-degree angle, warm natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:ehime/botchan-dango: Three Botchan dango skewers on a small plate, each with three soft balls in green, yellow and brown bean-paste coatings, beside a cup of green tea on a wooden bench, 45-degree angle, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.
s:kochi/kochi-castle: Kochi Castle: a white-walled keep with black-trimmed windows and layered grey tiled roofs above tall curving stone walls, cherry trees in full pink bloom in the foreground, clear blue spring sky, bright late-morning light.
s:kochi/hirome-market: Inside Hirome Market: a lively covered food hall with rows of wooden communal tables and small food stalls around the edges, tall orange straw flames searing bonito at a stall in the background, warm indoor light, small distant diners.
s:kochi/katsurahama: Katsurahama Beach: a gentle crescent of coarse sand, rugged rocks topped with pine trees, a small shrine on a rocky outcrop, strong white Pacific waves rolling in, deep blue sea, bright sunny afternoon, clear sky.
s:kochi/shimanto-chinkabashi: Sada Chinkabashi on the Shimanto River: a long, low concrete bridge with no railings stretching across wide, calm, clear green water, pebble river beaches and forested hills on both sides, bright early-summer sunlight, gentle reflections.
s:kochi/niyodo-blue: Nikobuchi on the Niyodo River system: a small waterfall pouring into a deep, clear, vivid blue-green pool surrounded by mossy rocks and dense green forest, sunlight filtering through the trees onto the water, calm summer midday.
s:kochi/makino-botanical: Makino Botanical Garden on Mount Godai: winding paths through lush beds of native Japanese wildflowers and ferns, a long low wooden building with a sweeping curved roof among the trees, soft spring sunlight, green hillside.
s:kochi/monet-garden: The water garden at Monet's Garden Marmottan in Kitagawa: a pond covered with pink and white water lilies, an arched footbridge, weeping willows and lush planting around the edges, bright summer morning light, calm reflections.
f:kochi/katsuo-tataki: Katsuo no tataki: thick slices of seared bonito with a charred smoky rim and deep red raw centre, topped with thin garlic slices, onion and green onion, ponzu pooled around, on a large ceramic plate, 45-degree angle, natural light, shallow depth of field.
f:kochi/sawachi: Kochi sawachi ryori: a huge round decorated platter piled with sashimi, sushi rolls, fried foods, simmered vegetables and fruit, colourful and abundant, on a low table in a tatami banquet room, overhead angle, soft warm light.
f:kochi/yuzu: Bright yellow yuzu citrus with bumpy skin and green leaves, one cut in half showing seeds and pale flesh, beside a small dish of green yuzu kosho paste and a glass of yuzu juice, on a wooden table, 45-degree angle, soft autumn light.
